notes: MVP uses C01–C03. C04–C05 are stretch/phase-2 only. Edge weights are estimated average transit times in seconds between camera FOVs under normal walking pace.

C01.description: Wide-angle view of the building entry doors and immediate foyer. High foot traffic, variable lighting (bright outdoors spill vs indoor fluorescent).

C02.description: Mid-corridor view covering the primary internal walkway. Connects entrance to stairwell and canteen branch. Moderate occlusion from pillars.

C03.description: Wide view of the seating and serving area. Crowded during lunch hours, sparse otherwise. Good lighting, minimal occlusion.

C05.notes: Exit to outdoor courtyard — stretch only

C04.description: Covers the stairwell exit and second-floor hallway junction. Narrower FOV, useful for testing ID persistence across elevation change.

C05.description: Outdoor area. Tests re-ID under daylight, shadow variation, and background clutter.
